equations: research = G + P_prefix + W_statement + S_prove + N*Vs
cost_conclusion_review.reason: Using the explicitly measured per-receiver boundaries, Vs > Vn and added producer components are nonnegative, so the difference stays positive for N>=1 independently of shared G. This is an observation about this path, not an optimal-implementation theorem.
cost_conclusion_review.shared_costs: Only genuinely identical common frontend work can cancel in an additive comparison; it cannot disappear from a ratio denominator.
cost_conclusion_review.prefix_reuse: Existing-prefix cost can be zero at an already-supplied-input boundary, while its creation/retention is upstream. Fused producer reuse may avoid a separate reconstruction; neither unavoidable reconstruction nor zero upstream retention cost is proved.
